name: Publir – Holistic Revenue Engine (HRE) Plugin
author: publirump

sections.description:
Publir’s Holistic Revenue Engine (HRE) plugin allows publishers to integrate our monetization platform into their WordPress websites. Experts in digital monetization, Publir provides complete solutions for maximizing revenue through Dynamic Ad Optimization and Audience Monetization. With just one line of code, our platform deploys brand-safe ads, a smart subscription firewall, and powerful reporting tools that ensure sustainable and diversified growth for content creators.

Dynamic Ad Optimization: Publir’s optimization tool automatically delivers the highest-paying ads across every page and device, leveraging real-time header bidding, AI-driven management, and integrations with 150+ premium ad tech vendors. Fast, efficient auctioneering maximizes every impression’s value, maintaining a strong focus on ad quality and user experience.

Audience Monetization: Publir’s subscription solution helps you build loyal readerships by offering premium ad-free content, flexible pricing models, and a seamless paywall experience. Robust reporting enables data-driven strategies for subscriber growth, zero-party data collection, and revenue diversification.

Publir’s platform is fully privacy-compliant and ready for a third-party-cookie-less future, providing transparency, security, and the tools needed to thrive in today’s digital marketplace.

To get started, create your Publir account at: https://publir.com/app/register

External Dependencies

We are using Amazon Web Services to track Ad block page views for our clients. To facilitate tracking, our plugin will call the following URL: https://{amazon_service_node}.amazonaws.com/default/pAnalytics

Also to get the currency details and site-specific customizations enabled on Publir’s platform, we are using the following link: https://a.publir.com/subscriptions/{siteId}.json
sections.installation:
Visit the “Plugins » Add New” page inside your WordPress admin area.

Find the plugin by typing the Publir HRE. Select the plugin and Install it.

WordPress will now download and install the plugin for you. After this, you’ll notice the ‘Install Now’ button, which will change into the ‘Activate’ button. Go ahead and click on the activate button to start using the plugin.

After the activation please ensure you enter the site id, which you will get from Publir’s Patform https://publir.com/app/login, and a URL from where your users can register/login for subscriptions. Once you enter the site id and page URL for subscriptions, please make sure you save your changes.
sections.faq:
What is Publir?

Publir is a unified monetization platform established in 2011. We help websites maximize ad revenue with Dynamic Ad Optimization and grow sustainable recurring income with Audience Monetization.

How soon can I expect an increase in subscriptions to my website?

The growth rate of subscriptions depends on your target audience and content type. Most publishers experience steady growth over time, but patience and content consistency are key.

How much time would the setup take?

Account creation is self-service and takes about 5 minutes. You can manage the account setup yourself by registering through the Publir platform.

What are the products Publir currently offers?

Publir offers two primary products:

  • Dynamic Ad Optimization
    Maximize ad earnings through intelligent, real-time ad placement.
  • Audience Monetization
    Build a loyal subscriber base and diversify your revenue streams through a smart subscription system.
